messages:
Sam W: Quick heads-up — ran a 16-GPU pipeline/tensor trace on the recent 2.2.1 runtime build and saw a weird phase where compute stalls while the KV prefetcher is active. looks like allreduce/ringlet handoffs + prefetch thrash on hosts without NVLink is the common factor.
Maya L: Can you paste the flame/trace? which fabric and topology? :thinking:
Sam W: Attached the critical excerpt below (filtered to 500ms window). main things: multiple 1.2-2.8ms gaps where TPU-like compute waits for remote prefetch hits. affected nodes are mixed NVLink + PCIe-only.
```
# window 0x7f: timeline slices
[0.000 - 0.012] compute-kernel (tp stage)
[0.013 - 0.015] local-kv-prefetch (L2 miss->p2p)
[0.016 - 0.018] allreduce-ringlet (shuffle)
[0.019 - 0.020] compute-stall (wait for kv)
[0.021 - 0.024] kernel-switch (quant path)
# note: repeated pattern aligned to microbatch boundary
```
Liam P: Interesting. Looks like our kernel-selection heuristics are switching to the quant-friendly path at the same boundary as prefetch kicks off, causing scheduling jitter. Could be an allocator/stream ordering issue rather than fabric alone.
Anya S: I also see KV cache eviction spikes when PP stage 1 advances — prefetch pushes new keys and evicts hot prefixes on the same device, so next tensor parallel shard misses and requests over PCIe. That multiplies latency vs NVLink nodes where p2p is cheaper.
Kai R: We had an EFA-tail alert yesterday on cluster-9. Latency tail there is 100-300us higher than expected under concurrent p2p. For small messages that adds up on ringlets.
InfraBot: perf-alert: job=pp_tp_16gpu trace=2075123456 window=500ms anomaly=kv-prefetch-stall severity=warning
Maya L: Any quick microbench we can run to separate causes? e.g., isolate kernel-switch from prefetch by turning prefetch off or staggering prefetch offsets across pipeline stages.
Sam W: Yep, plan: (1) repro with prefetch disabled, (2) repro with prefetch but staggered by microbatch offset 2 (delay start of prefetch by N steps for alternate PP stages), (3) run ringlet p2p-only microbench p2p_latency.sh across NVLink vs PCIe nodes. I'll run 1 & 2 on cluster-7 (mixed nodes) tonight.
Liam P: On the runtime side I'll add a flag to force coherent kernel selection (no quant-path swap within a microbatch boundary) so we can test if kernel thrash amplifies stalls.
Anya S: If eviction is the issue, we should log KVCACHE evict counts per device. Add a lightweight counter and sample over the same window.
Kai R: If EFA tail dominates, we can consider fabric-aware routing: prefer NVLink-local ringlets for the critical KV prefetch path and fall back across EFA only for non-latency-critical syncs. That routing change is low-risk to test.
Sam W: TL;DR actionable: I run experiments tonight (prefetch off / stagger + evict counter). Liam will push kernel-lock build. Kai will schedule p2p microbench across NVLink vs EFA tomorrow. We reconvene tomorrow AM and compare traces. :thumbsup:
Maya L: Awesome. please drop traces in #eng-runtime/traces and add which commit and job-id.
Sam W: Will do. job ids: repro-2075123456-1 (prefetch-off) and repro-2075123456-2 (staggered-offset).
